title: Retagging a machine state
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine over Boolean symbols, with state set $S$. For any index $j$ in a type $I$ and any $q$ in a family of types $P_i$ indexed by $i\in I$, mapping the state of $c$ to the pair $(j,q)$ gives the same configuration as first mapping its state to $q$ and then mapping that state to $(j,q)$.
hypotheses_covered: $I$ is a type and $P_i$ is a type for each $i\in I$
